superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: U 07:39 u subotu, Parking Servis i zvanični i vazduhoplovni meteorološki izvori dele starost poslednjeg prijema od 21 min, što možda odražava ritam prikupljanja, a ne događaj u gradu. Prikaz za Donji grad pomerio se sa 124 na 340, ali bez vremena merenja taj pomak mogu povezati samo sa prijemima, ne sa naslovima o incidentu ili stanju sistema. [F1][F4][F27][F28][F5][F6][F13]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: At 07:39 on Saturday [F1], Parking Servis and the official and aviation weather feeds share a last-reception age of 21 min [F4][F27][F28], which may reflect collection cadence rather than a city event. The Donji grad display moved from 124 to 340 [F5], but without measurement time [F4] I can connect that movement only to receptions, not to the incident or service headlines [F6][F13].
